what_happened: Research confirmed the --no-revert untracked-backup enumeration in git-snapshot.sh is used by no mode other than --no-revert (default/--branch use git stash push -u instead), so scoping it to the dispatching task's file_scope costs nothing to the other modes. Also discovered a structurally identical unexcluded stage_paths seed in scripts/orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh (line 2080), outside this task's declared file_scope -- flagged in the report's Risks section rather than edited.

Plan-time premise re-validation found this repository's root .gitignore already carries **/untracked-backup-*/ (added by the work that introduced --no-revert mode), while the repository where the incident reproduced carries no such pattern. That asymmetry, not a script difference, explains the incident's locality and reframed the class-registration work as a propagation fix rather than a new idea -- avoiding a plan that would have described a no-op as a behavior change here.

Follow-up to carry forward: scripts/orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh builds a structurally identical fixed task-directory stage_paths seed for the whole-task completion commit. It is outside this record's declared file_scope, so the plan records it as a Non-Goal with a follow-up note rather than widening scope silently.

Demonstrated RED for both halves of the snapshot-artifact containment defect before any fix landed. test-git-snapshot.sh's new containment-scoping case: the unmodified --no-revert enumeration copied a foreign specs/901_foreign_task/ directory into the backup (exit=0, has_foreign=yes). test-git-commit-phase.sh's new Case 42: the unmodified fixed stage_paths seed committed both working-progress-*.patch and untracked-backup-*/ holding a foreign path (rc=0, both tracked after commit).

Both suites' existing fixture helpers (make_scoped_repo/run_snapshot in test-git-snapshot.sh; build_repo/write_progress/run_phase_commit in test-git-commit-phase.sh) covered the two new regression cases with no new scaffolding needed.

Follow-up noted, not performed here (NON-GOALS): scripts/orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh builds a structurally identical fixed stage_paths-style seed at its own whole-task completion commit site, which carries the same unconditional directory-pathspec exposure to the two snapshot-artifact classes that git-commit-phase.sh's seed just had fixed in it. Porting the same conditional :(exclude) entries to that seed is a small, separate piece of work.

test-runtime-file-tracking.sh's own Case 5 hardcoded the pre-existing class-member count (27) as a literal exact-match assertion, not derived from any shared constant; adding the 28th member (untracked-backup) required updating that literal and its descriptive breakdown string in the source-store copy, then a second deploy-headless.sh pass to propagate the fix into the deployed copy before the suite could show green against the deployed tree.

Both deploy-headless.sh runs (pre- and post-Case-5-fix) reported RESULT=landed_verify_clean with no failures; every one of the 28 lockstep-parallel-array entries, the two new regression cases, and the pre-existing 104 cases in both target suites passed against the deployed tree with no regression.
git-commit-phase.sh dropped 'agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/test-runtime-file-tracking.sh' from a phase commit pathspec: not contained in this task's declared file_scope.
